name: Touchtry FashionAR
author: touchtry

sections.description:
Touchtry FashionAR is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that adds augmented reality (AR) try-on functionality to WooCommerce stores.

Store owners can attach AR models or external AR links to products and display a “Try On” button directly on product pages. This allows customers to preview fashion items in real-time using their device camera without installing any app.

Key Features:

  • Add AR Try-On button to WooCommerce products
  • Supports WebAR (no app required)
  • Custom AR link integration per product
  • Works with most WooCommerce themes
  • Lightweight and performance optimized
  • No coding required

Privacy:

This plugin does not collect, store, or share any personal user data.

External Services:

AR experiences may load from external URLs provided by the store owner. These services may have their own privacy policies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/touchtry-fashionAR/ directory, or install via WordPress plugin uploader.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce products and add your AR link/model.
  4. The “Try On” button will automatically appear on product pages.
sections.faq:
Does this require an app?

No, it uses WebAR so users can try products directly in their browser.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, it works on supported mobile browsers.

Can I use my own AR models?

Yes, you can attach your own AR links or models.
